titulo: Final project in Gestoria + What changed
lead: The final project of the program is to manage an operation from end to end: understand it, redesign it, divide the work, equip the agent, run it, evaluate it and improve it. You log the operation in Gestoria, build the 14-step report and run it through the rubric that brings together the program's courses. At the end, you'll see what changed in the market, with a date and a source.
objetivo: run an operation from end to end through the 14 steps in Gestoria and get the final report approved by the program's 8-item rubric.

aprende.t: The 14 steps and where each one lives in Gestoria
The final report with the pieces from the program's courses
The 8-item rubric and the 7 required items
What changed through October 2026 in governance, rules and certifications

hero_alt: The manager presents a bound report and a wall dashboard to a small team and the company owner; through the window, the warehouse with pallets.

secoes.sub: Each phase groups steps that use the same pieces. Tap each phase.
secoes.volta: Improving takes you back to the start: the next cycle begins from the new version

nos.detalhe: Understand the goal and analyze the process that exists, with an owner, a trigger, a finish line and a baseline. Pieces from G2 (canvas, map). In Gestoria: the Processes screen (name, owner, expected outcome, volume, current time).

Eliminate steps that exist only out of habit and redesign the flow before automating, with the reason for each cut. Pieces from G2. In Gestoria: the steps of the new version, one per line; the cuts and reasons go in the report.
Decide what stays with people (G1) and what goes to the agents, with role and delegation (G3). In Gestoria: Workforce screen (mission, receives, delivers).

Choose the model and tools based on the work (G4), set permissions and owners (G3 and lessons 1 and 2 of this course), and establish the cost per outcome and the cap (G4). In Gestoria: model, tools, can and cannot, initial autonomy, cost per hour and budget.

Define the metrics before running (lesson 4), run routine cases, doubtful ones and ones outside the policy, and observe the human decisions. In Gestoria: Overview (simulate) and Human decisions (approve or send back with a justification).

Evaluate with an answer key and classes (lesson 3) and improve with a LOOP-R cycle with promotion or rollback (lessons 5 and 6). In Gestoria: Evaluations and Continuous improvement (Proposed, Testing, Validated, Promoted).

secoes.legenda: The steps are those of the final project of the AI Management area (§07). The area announces fourteen steps and lists thirteen items, because it combines "human tasks and agent tasks"; here they are two steps, one from G1 and one from G3. Educational approval alone does not authorize any change in the company.

secoes.titulo: From Gestoria to the signed report
secoes.sub: Gestoria is a local lab: it stores process, roles, runs, decisions, evaluations and improvements, and exports everything as JSON. It does not generate a report or run a real model. The report is this lesson's template.

passos.titulo: Register the process and the agent
texto: Open Gestoria and, in Processes, create the process with a human owner, expected outcome, weekly volume, current human time per case, cost per hour, accuracy target, lab budget and the steps of the new version.
In Workforce, create the agent's role: owner, planned model, mission, receives, delivers, can, cannot, context, Skills, tools and initial autonomy (at most "Prepares").

exemplo.texto: Process "Order via WhatsApp → invoicing", owner Patrícia, 170 cases per week, 4.4 min of human time per case, R$ 50 per hour (average of the human hours from G4: R$ 2,502 ÷ 49.8 h), accuracy target 95%, 8 steps. Agent Hora, owner Patrícia, initial autonomy "Prepares".

texto: In Overview, simulate at least one case of each scenario: routine within the policy, conflicting information and a request outside the policy. In Human decisions, approve or send back each one, with a justification that another person can understand.
Each simulation costs R$ 0.38 and 42 teaching seconds, with no charge. Record in the report the 5-indicator dashboard from lesson 4 with the numbers from your real case or from Horizonte.

exemplo.texto: "Sent back: the customer asked for 15% and the agent's authority limit is 5%; prepare a proposal up to 10% for Patrícia to approve."

texto: In Evaluations, log at least 10 of your 30 cases, with answer key, outcome and class, including a critical one, if there is one. To promote an agent level, the tool asks for 100 cases of the current version, with no critical errors: the project does not require this.

In Continuous improvement, log the LOOP-R cycle and advance from Proposed to Promoted, one stage at a time, with the evidence. The tool has no "rolled back" stage: the rollback goes in the report, and the agent can be paused.

exemplo.texto: Improvement "route table in the context": Promoted with the evidence from cycle 0001; in the report, the week 8 rollback and the proposed v2.3.

passos.sub: whoever builds it does not sign it
texto: Export the JSON in Lab data, fill in the 14-step report with the pieces from the courses and run it through the rubric: 75 points or more and all 7 required items. Run the review panel prompt before handing it in.
Whoever built it does not sign it. At Horizonte, Patrícia builds it, Rafael confirms the safeguards and Carlos signs it, and only then does he decide whether Hora goes into billing.

exemplo.texto: Gestoria stores the data in this browser. Export the JSON and keep a copy: clearing the browser erases the work.

SIGNED BY (not the person who built it): <name> on <date>

FINAL RUBRIC · AI Management Program 2027 · pass with >= 75 AND the 7 mandatory items

ITEM                                   SOURCE POINTS CRITERION FOR FULL POINTS
1. Process and outcome                   G2     15    name with a start and an end; owner and backup;
                                                      trigger and completion; outcome for the
                                                      company; baseline marked
2. Steps cut before automating           G2     10    each step eliminated or moved with a reason
                                                      and new source; real requirements kept
3. Agents                                G3     15    role with mission, verifiable deliverable,
                                                      prohibitions and owner; delegation;
                                                      constitution; matrix with color per action and
                                                      approval with content and deadline
4. People                                G1     10    what stays with people, by task;
                                                      conversation with what changes, what does not
                                                      change and what we don't know; supervisors
                                                      trained, with a backup; evaluation that
                                                      does not punish whoever points out an agent's error
5. Resources                             G4     10    model chosen on cases, critical one
                                                      separate, with an alternative; context with
                                                      an owner; minimum access; cost per completed
                                                      task (with human time and rework),
                                                      cap and estimated ROI in scenarios
6. Governance                            G5     15    owners per action with one name;
                                                      own identity, permission and log (10
                                                      items); access review; timeline
7. Measurement                           G5     15    30 cases with answer key, rubric and 4 classes;
                                                      5 indicators with denominator, baseline,
                                                      limit and owner
8. One LOOP-R cycle                      G5     10    7 steps; hypothesis with guardrail and
                                                      tolerance; decision by someone who did not propose it;
                                                      promotion or roll back with trigger

MANDATORY (one missing fails)
[ ] Process owner and each agent's owner, by name
[ ] Baseline observed or marked as a hypothesis, with an indicator that has a denominator
[ ] Nothing irreversible in green and a cap in numbers where there is value
[ ] Whoever enters it does not approve it: no executor approves their own action; report signed by someone else
[ ] Critical errors counted separately, never in the average
[ ] Roll back with a trigger in numbers and the previous version identified
[ ] Fictional or anonymized data identified as such

abas.html:
Horizonte, fictional study company · what goes into each screen

  • Processes: "Order via WhatsApp → invoicing" · Sales · Patrícia · 170 cases per week · 4.4 min of human time per case · R$ 50 per hour (G4 average) · accuracy target 95% · lab budget R$ 20 · the 8 steps of version 2.0 of the process (G2).
  • Workforce: Hora · owner Patrícia · mission, receives, delivers and prohibitions from the role sheet (G3) · context: catalog, discount policy, route table with an owner · initial autonomy "Prepares".
  • Overview and Human decisions: 3 simulated cases (routine, conflicting, outside the policy), each with a decision and a justification.
  • Evaluations: 10 of the 30 cases from lesson 3, including T-27 as a critical error in the previous version.
  • Continuous improvement: "Route table in the context," from Proposed to Promoted, with the evidence from cycle 0001.
  • In the report, outside the tool: the step cuts with reasons, what stays with people, the responsibility matrix, the checklist, the dashboard, the week 8 roll back, and the timeline.

Assembled by Patrícia; safeguards confirmed by Rafael; signed by Carlos. The decision to take Hora to billing remains his.

• Report without an attachment. Each step points to the piece that proves it (file, screen, JSON).
  • Promoting a level in the lab with few cases. The tool asks for 100 cases of the current version; the project does not require a level promotion.
  • Forgotten rollback. The tool has no "rolled back" step: write it in the report.
  • The person who built it signs. Fails the required item "whoever enters it does not approve it".
  • Real data without authorization. Use anonymized or fictional data and say which.

secoes.sub: Quarterly panel, swapped out at each course revision. Each item with a date, source and type of claim. The method in lessons 1 to 7 does not depend on any product mentioned.

texto: Okta, AI Agents at Work 2026 (survey by an identity vendor): almost two thirds of organizations apply weaker security controls to agents than to employees. Deloitte (09/17/2026): 50% of Brazilian companies have adopted AI and 27% have mature governance.
Gartner (02/17/2026, forecast): spending on AI governance goes from US$ 492 million in 2026 to more than US$ 1 billion in 2030.

exemplo.texto: The distance between using and governing is the space of the AI manager: matrix, checklist, evaluation, dashboard and a cycle that loops back.

texto: Stanford AI Index (04/13/2026): documented AI incidents went from 233 to 362. EU AI Act: the Digital Omnibus package (07/24/2026) postponed the Annex III high-risk rules to 12/02/2027; AI literacy already applies in the EU.
Brazil: Bill PL 2338/2023 was reported as stalled in the Chamber of Deputies (secondary source, 08/24/2026; check the official record).

exemplo.texto: Update the lesson 7 timeline at each revision. A date that changes does not change the method.

texto: Governance: AIGP (IAPP, since 04/2024), strong on privacy and legal. Security: AAISM (ISACA, 08/2025), requires CISM or CISSP. Management system: ISO/IEC 42001, which certifies the company; the auditor or implementer course is for the individual.
In the October 2026 search, no independent certification for managing agents was found. The vendor ones (NVIDIA, GitHub, Google, Oracle) are about building agents, not managing them.

exemplo.texto: Anyone who needs AIGP or ISO/IEC 42001 for the job still needs them. The INEMA certification is a qualification.

texto: Who pays and what do they sell? Okta and Microsoft sell the solution to the problem they measure; consultancies sell the transformation they describe. How did they measure? A survey with a sample, self-reported experience or a forecast?

An analysis on The Microsoft Cloud blog points out that the Work Trend Index 2026 numbers should not carry a business case on their own. A report is a map, never proof of your case: the proof is your dashboard.

exemplo.texto: January 2027, with the overview of the following quarter.

degraus.passo: The foundation: without a name for each action and without a log, no number later has an owner or a trail. The lesson 2 checklist comes along with it.

degraus.saida: Set with answer key, rubric and result per version.
degraus.passo: Requires the matrix: whoever writes the answer key is whoever answers for the policy. The critical ones become guardrails before any improvement.

degraus.saida: Dashboard with 5 indicators and 4 weeks of baseline.
degraus.passo: Requires the current stable version. The 4 weeks of collection run while you do the following lessons.

degraus.saida: One LOOP-R cycle with a logged promotion or rollback.
degraus.passo: Requires the baseline and the 30 cases. Promotion brings back the trigger from lesson 6.

rolagem_fim.texto: Govern, evaluate, measure, and evolve, in this order. The final report joins these deliverables to those from G2, G3, G4, and G1.

secoes.sub: Horizonte in Gestoria to practice the rubric; your own process for real.

exercicios.texto: In Gestoria, add the process and the Hora with the data from the sample tab. Run the 3 scenarios and decide each one with a justification. Log 10 of the 30 cases from lesson 3 and the improvement from cycle 0001 through to Promoted, with the evidence. Export the JSON, fill in the 14-step report with Horizonte's deliverables, and run it through the rubric and the review panel prompt.
exercicios.pronto: besides the examples that already come with Gestoria, the exported JSON contains Horizonte's process, Hora, 3 of its runs with a justified decision, 10 of its evaluations, and 1 Promoted improvement with evidence; the report has the 14 steps filled in and the week 8 roll back; the score is 75 or more with the 7 mandatory items; and the name of whoever signs is different from whoever assembled it.

exercicios.texto: Do the same with your own process, using the deliverables from the "in your process" practices in all the courses of the program. Anything missing from a course you haven't taken goes in marked as pending, with a date. Hand it to someone who is accountable for the process and didn't build any of it, ask them to check the required items, and note their questions.
exercicios.pronto: your process report has all 14 steps with an attachment for each, a score of 75 or higher with the 7 required items, the Gestoria JSON attached, and the signature (or written acceptance) of the person who is accountable for the process and did not put it together.

exercicios.texto: Use the generator above to build the plan with your dates, and download the .ics file for your calendar.
exercicios.pronto: the plan is saved and the dates are on your calendar.

secoes.sub: 4 questions. The explanation appears after your attempt.

perguntas.p: The report scored 90 points, but the dashboard shows "97% accuracy" with a critical error hidden in the average. Result?
opcoes: Approved, because 90 points is well above 75
Approved with a caveat, to be fixed at the next review of the report
Failed: a critical error in the average breaks a mandatory item
perguntas.explica: The mandatory items exist so a high score cannot hide a big problem. The report goes back to item 7, not to zero.

perguntas.p: Gestoria does not have a "rolled back" step in Continuous improvement. How do you log the week 8 rollback?
opcoes: In the report, with the trigger, number, cause and previous version
Don't log it, because the tool doesn't offer the step
Delete the improvement from the tool, so nobody gets confused
perguntas.explica: The tool is a lab with declared limits. The log that counts is the report, with the version history from lesson 6; if needed, pause the agent.

perguntas.p: Horizonte's report passed the rubric. Can Hora go to collections on Monday?
opcoes: Yes, because the rubric approved Hora's entire operation
It can, if Rafael confirms the safeguards are in the tool
Yes, if Patrícia also signs the approved report
Carlos decides; collections starts as a new task
perguntas.explica: The approval is educational and does not authorize production. Collections is a change of role: it starts at yellow, with its own cases.

perguntas.p: A vendor report says that people who use its product control agents better. How do you use it in your project?
opcoes: As proof that the vendor's product solves your company's problem
As a map: who paid, how they measured and whether it is a forecast
Ignore it, because a vendor report is worthless
perguntas.explica: A vendor sells the solution to the problem it measures. Use the report to know what to ask; the proof for your case is your own dashboard.

secoes.titulo: After the program: helping other companies
paragrafos: This program prepares people who manage agents inside the company. If what you want is to help other companies adopt AI safely, as a consultant, auditor, mentor or trainer, the next path is Profissional 2030, which uses the same Horizonte seen from the outside.
The video below is optional: it shows why building agents stops being enough and what to learn to work as a consultant in 2027.
